description: We are brothers. One is an absolute genius teenager with perfect school grades whose greatest dream is visiting NASA. He is a phenomenal game and app developer who knows absolutely everything about the universe. The other is a profoundly dedicated doctor healing infections and rehabilitating patients. He is also a brilliant programmer and outstanding founder creating startups to help humanity.
summary:
A.U.R.A. (Autonomous Universal Rehabilitation & Assessment) is a 100% offline medical and psychological ecosystem designed for deep-space missions where communication delays with Earth make real-time telemedicine impossible.
​At the core of A.U.R.A. are two integrated AI modules: Doctor F.O.X. (Full Organism eXamination) and E.M.M.A. (Emotional & Mental Monitoring Assistant).
​Doctor F.O.X. handles physical health telemetry and hardware diagnostics through two custom prototypes:
​1. Smart Biometric Bracelet (ESP32): Continuously tracks heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO2 via MAX30102), and body temperature (DS18B20), streaming real-time data over a local offline Wi-Fi network with instant RGB LED hazard alerts.
​2. Smart Space Toilet / Chemical Lab (Arduino Nano): Performs non-invasive urinalysis using an optical RGB color sensor (TCS3200) and a conductivity probe (TDS) to detect early signs of bone calcium loss (osteopenia), kidney stones, dehydration, and radiation-induced hematuria.
​E.M.M.A. safeguards astronaut mental health during prolonged isolation and confinement. Operating offline via local AI models and external camera/microphone analysis, E.M.M.A. detects stress, fatigue, and depression, automatically triggering 360° VR Therapy and adaptive circadian lighting protocols to restore psychological balance.
​Together, A.U.R.A. empowers astronauts to autonomously monitor, diagnose, and protect their lives in deep space.
​
details:
What does it do and how does it work? A.U.R.A. (Autonomous Universal Rehabilitation & Assessment) is a complete, 100% offline medical and psychological telemetry ecosystem designed for deep-space missions (Moon, Mars, and orbital stations) where communication delays with Earth reach up to 40 minutes and cloud dependency is impossible. A.U.R.A. integrates two specialized AI subsystems into a single offline HTML5/JavaScript dashboard powered by local machine learning:

1. Doctor F.O.X. (Full Organism eXamination) — Physical Telemetry & Hardware Diagnostics: Smart Biometric Bracelet (ESP32-S-WROOM): Operates as an autonomous offline Wi-Fi Access Point (DOCTOR_FOX_AP, IP 192.168.4.1). It continuously monitors heart rate and blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) via an optical MAX30102 sensor and core/skin temperature via a waterproof DS18B20 probe. An onboard RGB LED (pins 15, 16, 17) acts as an instant physical hazard indicator (Green = Normal, Yellow = Warning, Blinking Red = Critical Alert) controlled directly by the web interface. Smart Space Toilet / Chemical Lab (Arduino Nano): Performs non-invasive, automated urinalysis via USB Serial (Web Serial API). It uses a TCS3200 RGB optical color sensor (pins D4, D5, D8) to detect hematuria (micro-bleeding caused by radiation or kidney stones) and severe dehydration, alongside a TDS conductivity probe (pin A0 with internal pull-up) to measure dissolved calcium and electrolytes—providing early warnings for microgravity-induced bone loss (osteopenia) and hypercalciuria. 2. E.M.M.A. (Emotional & Mental Monitoring Assistant) — Psychological Care & VR Therapy: Analyzes astronaut facial expressions and voice tone via an external camera and microphone using local offline AI models (Ollama / Llama 3.2) and offline speech synthesis (Piper TTS). When signs of claustrophobia, isolation stress, loneliness, or circadian rhythm disruption are detected, E.M.M.A. automatically launches 360° VR Nature Therapy (Side-by-Side 3D rendering for VR headsets/smart glasses) and adjusts habitat lighting protocols. What benefits does it have and what is the intended impact? Zero Cloud Dependency: Works completely offline without internet, external routers, or Earth mission control intervention. Early Disease Prevention in Microgravity: Simultaneously tackles the top NASA Human Research Program (HRP) hazards—radiation, altered gravity (bone calcium loss, cardiovascular deconditioning), and isolation/confinement. Dual Space & Earth Impact: Beyond deep space, A.U.R.A.'s low-cost, autonomous architecture can be deployed in remote rural clinics, submarines, polar stations, and home rehabilitation centers on Earth. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did we use? Hardware: ESP32-S-WROOM, Arduino Nano (ATmega328P), MAX30102 Pulse Oximeter, DS18B20 Temperature Sensor, TCS3200 Color Sensor, TDS Conductivity Probe, RGB LED modules, VR Headset / Smart Glasses prototype. Software & Languages: C/C++ (Arduino/ESP32 firmware), Python (Scikit-learn, Pandas, Flask, Joblib, PySerial, automated Arduino-CLI batch installer START.bat & builder.py), HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (Web Serial API, Fetch API, A-Frame / WebGL 3D VR), Local LLM (Ollama), and Piper TTS. NASA Data: Trained and calibrated using physiological parameters and risk profiles from the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), NASA Human Research Program (HRP), and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) datasets. How is our project creative and what factors did our team consider? Our team—combining medical rehabilitation expertise with software and hardware engineering—designed A.U.R.A. around real-world usability under extreme constraints: One-Click Automated Deployment: We built a custom intelligent firmware installer (START.bat + builder.py) that automatically downloads compilers, wipes memory, and flashes both microcontrollers without requiring the user to configure complex IDEs. Closed-Loop Biofeedback: Instead of passive charts, A.U.R.A. creates an active feedback loop—connecting real-time blood, pulse, and urine chemistry directly to AI voice guidance, physical LED alerts on the astronaut's wrist, and immersive VR rehabilitation. Выбери там Yes (Да), и если откроется текстовое поле для описания ИИ, вставь туда вот эту короткую строчку: AI Usage Disclosure: We used Google Gemini and Google AI Studio to assist in structuring our web interface code, refining English documentation, and generating concept avatars (marked accordingly without NASA branding). Additionally, our project integrates local offline AI models (Scikit-learn for biometric anomaly detection, Ollama for psychological assistant E.M.M.A., and Piper TTS for offline voice synthesis).
